label: Payments by Tender Type
description: Tenders in a payment-date window by tender type: count and amount of live tenders, cancelled tenders shown apart, with a month-by-month breakdown under each type.
subreport: reports/subreports/payments_by_tender_type_month.jrxml  (a local jrxml resource of the unit named payments_by_tender_type_month; the main says repo:payments_by_tender_type_month)

inputControls.label: Tender type (blank = all)
inputControls.query: SELECT TRIM(tender_type_cd) AS CODE, TRIM(tender_type_cd) || ' - ' || descr AS DESCR FROM CISADM.CI_TENDER_TYPE_L WHERE language_cd = 'ENG' ORDER BY 1
